errors.text_span: IE-Germanic shows moderate values for the L₂ series (~8 and ~10), near-zero to slightly negative values for the R₂ series (around 0 to −1), and larger B₂ values (both around ~15)
errors.evidence: The R₂ series (light green and dark green) for IE-Germanic are not near-zero or negative; they are positive and closer to 3-4. The B₂ values are also not both around ~15; one is closer to 12.
The L₂ values for IE-Indic are not near-zero; they are approximately 8-10 for mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂.

errors.text_span: IE-Romance shows mid-range L₂ and R₂ values (~6, ~4–5, ~5, and ~1)
errors.evidence: The L₂ and R₂ values for IE-Romance are not accurately described. The L₂ values are closer to 3-5, and the R₂ values are around 15-18, not ~1.

errors.text_span: Semitic shows L₂ values around ~11 and ~16, R₂ values below 0 (roughly −2 to −1), and B₂ values around ~15 and ~19–20
errors.evidence: The R₂ values for Semitic are not below 0; they are positive and closer to 1-2. The B₂ values are also not around ~19-20; they are closer to 10-12.

errors.evidence: The color mapping is incorrect. mBERT-L₂ is light blue, not light cyan. mBERT-B₂ is pink, but the description says 'light pink,' which is misleading as the color is distinctly pink, not a lighter shade.
The description omits the exact value range of the vertical axis (0 to 40) and the tick intervals (5 units), which are mentioned in the reference.
The description does not explicitly mention that the bars within each category are visually separated to facilitate model-wise comparison, as noted in the reference.
